facts.fact: The document says eKash, Rwanda's national interoperable payment system, lets users send and receive money between participating banks and mobile-money platforms using existing accounts, and the campaign involves mobile-money operators (KT Press, BNR).
The document says eKash allows money to move between participating banks and mobile-money platforms using their existing accounts.
The document says Rwanda made eKash its national instant payment system in July 2026, connecting banks and mobile-money platforms through a common payment infrastructure.
